correctness.rationale: Twelve displayed primitive line vectors were read from frozen RESULT.md and compared with the gradients of F=X^4+Y^4+Z^4+3sum X²Y². An independently written SymPy Gaussian-integer determinant enumeration covered all 220 triples, finding no zero and norm histogram {4:8,20:48,36:24,40:24,64:12,80:48,100:48,200:8}; all odd prime factors are 3 or 5. Thus no triple concurrency or pair collapse for any odd p≥7, giving 66 double points. Independent F9 arithmetic normalized all twelve reductions at p3 and enumerated geometric pairwise intersections: 36 points, specifically 30 double and six quadruple, six F3-rational. At p5, two i embeddings independently yield four distinct lines, each with three original labels; the four linear forms multiply exactly to F modulo5 and have six distinct rational doubles. For p≥7 split i∈Fp yields 66 Fp points; nonsplit i gives six conjugate-pair intersections rational, and no others because triple points are excluded. The all-prime assertion is certified by exact integer determinant norms, not by sampled primes.

originality.rationale: Dimca–Ilardi–Pokora–Sticlaru (arXiv:2301.01117) give the exact complex twelve hyperflex tangent lines and state 66 ordinary double points; this original input is not claimed as new. Pacini–Testa (arXiv:1301.1865) study the same Edge quartic/projective-dual hyperinflection set and its reconstruction/stabilizer; their exceptional p13 is a symmetry phenomenon, not a new line-incidence degeneration. The independently computed p3/p5 fibers, determinant-based all-good-prime bound and Fp rational-point counts do not follow from the characteristic-zero statement. Edge 1945 original accessible only in extract; full lawful Oxford request produced vpn_disconnected, so historic overlap is a named risk.
residual_risks: Edge 1945 full four-page historical article was inaccessible due to institutional VPN disconnection; possible previously reported arithmetic incidence not excluded.
The different 28-bitangent arrangement literature was not exhaustively inspected in full; it is a different divisor.

value.rationale: The complete exceptional-prime incidence classification of a canonical twelve-line tangent configuration is a natural arithmetic specialization problem: it identifies exactly where the intersection lattice jumps and separately resolves rational vs geometric points. The obstruction-norm proof uniformly excludes all other odd primes; the exceptional p3 and p5 geometries have sharply different structure and provide useful test cases for reductions of complex arrangements.

limitations: Characteristic2 excluded; reductions treated as reduced support despite triple label coincidences at p5.
